# Weld.Credo.Check.NoRuntimeOsEnv

Source: https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Credo.Check.NoRuntimeOsEnv.md

# `Weld.Credo.Check.NoRuntimeOsEnv`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/weld/blob/main/lib/weld/credo/check/no_runtime_os_env.ex#L1)

## Basics

> #### This check is disabled by default. {: .neutral}
>
> [Learn how to enable it](`e:credo:config_file.html#checks`) via `.credo.exs`.

This check has a base priority of `high` and works with any version of Elixir.

## Explanation

Runtime application code should not read or mutate OS environment variables
directly. Read deployment env at config/runtime.exs or a Config.Provider
boundary, then pass explicit options, config structs, credential providers,
or caller-supplied maps into libraries and SDKs.

## Check-Specific Parameters

*There are no specific parameters for this check.*

## General Parameters

Like with all checks, [general params](`e:credo:check_params.html`) can be applied.

Parameters can be configured via the [`.credo.exs` config file](`e:credo:config_file.html`).

# Weld.Manifest.Artifact

Source: https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Manifest.Artifact.md

# `Weld.Manifest.Artifact`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/weld/blob/main/lib/weld/manifest.ex#L8)

Normalized artifact configuration.

# `t`

```elixir
@type t() :: %Weld.Manifest.Artifact{
  id: String.t(),
  include: [String.t()],
  mode: :package_projection | :monolith,
  monolith_opts: keyword(),
  optional_features: [String.t()],
  output: Weld.Manifest.Output.t(),
  package: Weld.Manifest.Package.t(),
  roots: [String.t()],
  verify: Weld.Manifest.Verify.t()
}
```

# Weld.Manifest.Package

Source: https://weld.hexdocs.pm/Weld.Manifest.Package.md

# `Weld.Manifest.Package`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/weld/blob/main/lib/weld/manifest.ex#L39)

Package metadata for a generated artifact.

# `t`

```elixir
@type t() :: %Weld.Manifest.Package{
  description: String.t(),
  docs_main: String.t(),
  elixir: String.t(),
  licenses: [String.t()],
  links: %{optional(String.t()) =&gt; String.t()},
  maintainers: [String.t()],
  name: String.t(),
  otp_app: atom(),
  version: String.t()
}
```

# `Weld.Manifest.Verify`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/weld/blob/main/lib/weld/manifest.ex#L86)

Verification configuration for a generated artifact.

# `smoke_config`

```elixir
@type smoke_config() :: %{enabled: boolean(), entry_file: String.t() | nil}
```

# `t`

```elixir
@type t() :: %Weld.Manifest.Verify{
  artifact_tests: [String.t()],
  hex_build: boolean(),
  hex_publish: boolean(),
  smoke: smoke_config()
}
```
